# penult

> From an idea to a publication draft: research, write, style, illustrate, and post the draft for review


## Pages in this subsection

- [penult](penult.html.md): penult: from an idea to a publication draft, posted where its author can review it.
- [penult.base](penult.base.html.md): Errors, constants and the stage names shared across penult.
- [penult.github](penult.github.html.md): GitHub, through the &#96;gh&#96; and &#96;git&#96; commands: read an issue, post or edit a comment, find raw URLs.
- [penult.images](penult.images.html.md): Images for the essay: find existing ones, generate a few, and keep the ledger.
- [penult.store](penult.store.html.md): Where penult’s private data lives, and the preferences read from it.
- [penult.tools](penult.tools.html.md): The verbs: plain functions, JSON-ready in and out, the one list every surface is built from.
- [penult.workspace](penult.workspace.html.md): One essay’s workspace: its files, its state, and the seed and brief written into it.
